notes: The entreaty particle na takes its complete English formula *I pray you*, pronouns included (rule 30), headed on *pray*.
The waw of va-asitem takes the subordinator *that* (rules 14, 55); the explicit pronoun attem keeps *ye* and the verb only *will deal*.
In *my father's house* the possessive determiner is the suffix's own under rule 18 and the rectum is rendered as the English possessive (rule 29).
